description: Calculate an hour-based Qimen chart using the chai bu method and rotating plate only. date and time are local Gregorian wall-clock time at placeId (from search_birth_place); omitting placeId uses the same configured reference place as Xiaodao Daily Fortune, named in the result. Historical time zone and DST, longitude and equation of time produce local true solar time, then expressed in Beijing time. All four pillars, solar term and ju use that corrected moment; year/month pillars can differ from Bazi for the same instant. The day changes at 23:00, not selectable. Repeated wall-clock times need an explicit daylightSaving choice; nonexistent times are not calculated. Optional birthYearPillar is a full valid sexagenary pillar, not a numeric year or a single stem; obtain it from bazi_chart first because the year changes at Lichun. Jia uses its hidden Liu Yi stem. Returns nine-palace chart facts and optional birth-year stem locations, without interpretation rules. Chart text stays Chinese; language en adds English conventions and a field glossary. Gregorian date range: 1801-01-01 through 2099-12-31. 公历日期范围：1801-01-01 至 2099-12-31。

birthYearPillar.description: Valid full sexagenary birth-year pillar, e.g. 庚午 or 甲戌, obtained from Bazi.

date.description: Chart date in the local Gregorian calendar.

daylightSaving.description: Only supply a user-selected DST choice when the local time occurs twice.

placeId.description: Optional event place ID from search_birth_place; omitted uses the website reference place.
